title: Ummemezeli KaZamcolo Omkhulu
intro: Lo muntu wema njengensika yokukhuthazela amakhulu eminyaka, ebiza umphakathi ophikisayo ukuba ubheke ekukhanyeni kweqiniso ngenkathi ebhekene nokuhlekwa usulu nokulahlwa. Naphezu kwezimo ezinzima kanye nesisindo somyalezo ohlanganisa izizukulwane, le nceku yahlala iqinile emsebenzini wayo kwaze kwaba yilapho kukhishwa isinqumo sokugcina.
clues: Ngachitha iminyaka engamakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye namashumi amahlanu ngibiza abantu bami endleleni yokulunga, imini nobusuku, ngasese nasesidlangalaleni.
Ngabaxwayisa abantu bami ngesijeziso esibuhlungu, kodwa bafaka iminwe yabo ezindlebeni zabo futhi bazimboza ngezingubo zabo ngokuqhosha.
Ngayalwa ukuba ngakhe into enkulu phambi kwamehlo eNkosi yami, yize kwakungekho manzi abonakalayo.
Njengoba ngangisebenza, abaholi babantu bakithi babedlula bangihleka usulu, kodwa ngabatshela ukuthi maduze nje sizobahleka usulu.
Ngancenga ukuba inyama negazi lami lihlangane nami, kodwa bakhetha ukuyofuna indawo yokukhosela entabeni, bekholelwa ukuthi izobasindisa ekukhuphukeni kwamanzi.
Ekugcineni umkhumbi wami wahlala eNtabeni iJudi ngemva kokuba umhlaba ugwinye amanzi awo futhi isibhakabhaka sayeka ukuna kwemvula.
arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
